title: GTA 6 on Xbox Series S vs Series X
yt_title: GTA 6 on Series S: 720p 😬 Series S vs Series X explained
description: Digital Foundry: Xbox Series S runs GTA 6 at about 720p and often below 30 fps (around 20 fps in the heaviest scenes), while Series X holds about 1440p at 30 fps; DF suggests another console if you can. Rockstar targets 30 fps on every console, PS5 Pro included. If you own the game on Xbox, Xbox Cloud Gaming streams it too, even on Xbox One. Which one are you playing on?
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 on Series S runs at about 720p 😬 Which console are you playing on? 👇

lines.text: Xbox Series S owners, is it enough for GTA 6? Digital Foundry measured about 720p.
lines.headline: 1/4 · SERIES S

lines.text: Frame rate is a bigger gap. The Series S can dip to about 20 in the heaviest scenes. The Series X holds 30. Digital Foundry even suggests another console if you can.
